notes: Supplier cheque payment requests (VN_MAINTRNS_CHECK, own table): supplier/currency/date checks, supplier balance snapshot, invoice lines resolved against open invoices, authorised requests locked. Wave 3b: legacy LOVs (suppliers in range, cash boxes, banks and their branches as a cascading list, open invoices of the supplier on the lines).

VN_MAINTRNS_CHECK.SUPPLIER_ID.lov: select s.code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.code r from supplier s where nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 and nvl(s.supplier_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (s.code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and s.code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by 2

VN_MAINTRNS_CHECK.BOX_CODE.lov: select box_code || ' - ' || name_a d, box_code r from rp_boxs where nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or box_code in (select box_code from rp_boxs_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by 2

VN_MAINTRNS_CHECK.BANK_CODE.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from bank where nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or code in (select bank_code from bank_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by 2

VN_MAINTRNS_CHECK.BRANCH.lov: select b.code || ' - ' || b.desc_a d, b.code r from bank_branchs b, ac_master a where b.brnch_acc_chrt_no = a.account_number and b.bank_code = :PAGE_BANK_CODE order by 2

VN_SUBTRNS_CHECK.BILL_ID1.lov: select s.bill_id1 || ' / ' || s.bill_id2 || ' - ' || to_char(m.trns_date, 'DD-MM-YYYY') || nvl2(m.supplier_ref, ' - ' || m.supplier_ref, '') || ' - المتبقي ' || to_char(s.residual_value) d, s.bill_id1 r from vn_subtrns s, vn_maintrns m where m.trns_id in (select id from vn_trnstype where effect = 1) and nvl(s.residual_value, 0) != 0 and m.trns_id = s.trns_id and m.trns_serial = s.trns_serial and nvl(s.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and m.supplier_id = (select h.supplier_id from vn_maintrns_check h where h.serial = :PAGE_SERIAL) and m.currency_code = (select h.currency_code from vn_maintrns_check h where h.serial = :PAGE_SERIAL) and s.pay_type_code = (select h.pay_type_code from vn_maintrns_check h where h.serial = :PAGE_SERIAL) and s.total_value - vn_subtrns_payed_value(s.trns_id, s.trns_serial, s.bill_seq) != 0 and s.total_value - vn_subtrns_check_payed_value(s.trns_id, s.trns_serial, s.bill_seq) != 0 order by m.trns_date, s.bill_id1, s.bill_id2
